method: Deep-research replay from frozen 2023Q2 events. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff price regimes are bounded by each memo cutoff; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before memo lock.
Pre-cutoff regime snapshots use only bars on or before each cutoff.
Use as process/holdout evidence, not clean forward alpha.
